svg.aria-label: The Claude Code creature, wearing a BMO costume, sits on a dusk ridge and changes its own battery: it opens the compartment on its costume, lifts the spent orange cell out, its screen face goes dark while nothing is seated, it takes a fresh cell from a charger crate, seats it, the screen flickers back to life, and it smiles. Beside the caption handoff-fire.sh --recycle, a state line reads session live, watcher armed while the screen is lit and slash exit, relaunching in place while it is dark.
svg.title: self-recycle — a session changes its own battery
svg.desc: clawd in a BMO costume, changing its own battery, in one 7-second loop. The face is lit if and only if a cell is seated, so the creature is genuinely off for 1.85s of every loop — which is what handoff-fire.sh --recycle does to the pane it runs in. Same palette as the hero banner; nothing crosses the caption.
